name: Employment-based green-card backlog (Visa Bulletin history)
description: Monthly USCIS/DOS Visa Bulletin final-action dates and derived wait times, by chargeability country and employment-based preference (EB) level.
underlying_source: U.S. Department of State Visa Bulletin (public domain, U.S. government work). travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/legal/visa-law0/visa-bulletin.html
license: Underlying Visa Bulletin data is U.S. govt public domain; compilation via DavidBellamy/visa_dates (no explicit license).

columns.final_action_dates: Priority date that is current for that category/country/month (YYYY-MM-DD)
columns.visa_bulletin_date: The Visa Bulletin month this row reports (YYYY-MM-DD)
columns.visa_wait_time: Estimated wait in years (bulletin date minus final action date)
